It holds potential for both a luxurious family getaway and a thriving business venue, offering breathtaking vistas and a wealth of amenities, all complemented by a unique blend of heritage and modern sophistication.

title: Pennsylvania farmer protects 170-acre farm after 70 years, turns down big offers
description: After 70 years on his 170-acre Bear Meadows Farm in Pennsylvania, dairy farmer Jeff Biddle has permanently protected the land from development. He turned down two lucrative offers and finalised a conservation easement in July 2026, preserving the farm’s agricultural land, forests, wildlife habitat and water resources for the future.

title: Warrick Dunn’s charity has furnished 252 homes and helped 687 people

During his 1997 rookie NFL season, he launched Homes for the Holidays to support single-parent families buying their first homes. Nearly three decades later, Warrick Dunn Charities has furnished 252 homes and helped 687 people move into them. The programme also provides furnishings and down-payment assistance, extending Dunn’s legacy far beyond football.

Recently, he achieved an unprecedented third win of the Walter Payton Man of the Year Charity Challenge, channeling even more support to charitable causes.

title: From mountain guns to missiles and drones: How India's artillery evolved over nearly 200 years
description: India's artillery has historically shaped warfare since the mid-14th century and continues to modernize today. Recent operations have demonstrated the effectiveness of long-range firepower against adversaries across different borders. The Regiment of Artillery has expanded in capabilities, introducing advanced systems such as the Pinaka and Dhanush. There is a focus on integrating Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance for more effective operations.

42-year-old record broken: Trucker’s daughter Vithya Ramraj rewrites history
description: Vithya Ramraj broke PT Usha’s 42-year-old national record in the women’s 400m hurdles, clocking a personal best 54.75 seconds to win bronze at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya. The Indian hurdler had equalled Usha’s 55.42-second mark at Hangzhou in 2023. A trucker’s daughter from Coimbatore, Ramraj has since represented India at the Paris Olympics and won another bronze at the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships.

title: Big blow for India! Sable misses out on medal, finishes fourth in steeplechase
description: Avinash Sable secured fourth place in the men's 3000m steeplechase, just shy of a medal with a season-best finish of 8:21.67. In a brighter moment for India, Vithya Ramraj clinched a bronze in the women's 400m hurdles, achieving a personal best of 54.75 seconds. Meanwhile, Seema Kaliramna came close in the women’s discus throw, missing the podium with her throw of 59.88m.

title: Watch: Nepal hillside collapses in seconds, sweeps away houses in Baglung; 10 killed
MHA scraps 34 CISF posts after withdrawal from Patanjali food and herbal park
description: The home ministry has issued orders for the abolition of 34 sanctioned posts of the CISF at Patanjali Food and Herbal Park. This decision follows the withdrawal of CISF security services, which took place on May 4, 2026. The CISF had been providing security at the site since June 2015, after a violent incident. The ministry also instructed the CISF to ensure all outstanding dues are settled with the management.

title: 'Exposed' by 999 call, 5 men in mid-twenties: What happened near US-run base in UK
description: Five men were arrested near RAF Fairford following reports of suspicious activity involving three vans. Police responded efficiently after a local farmer reported hooded men approaching the military airbase, prompting a major security operation. Initial detentions were made under explosives legislation, subsequently leading to terrorism suspicions. Investigators are examining potential connections to hostile state actors amid heightened security concerns.

title: Nidhi Tiwari, influencer with 16 lakh followers, dies by suicide; final words stun fans
description: Nidhi Tiwari, a 30-year-old social media influencer, was found hanging at her residence in Singrauli. Her family reported that she had recently spoken to a youth from another state before her death. The local police are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death and have taken her body into custody. Tiwari had a significant following on social media, indicating her influence in the community.

title: Paid for AC bus, got non-AC ride and was dropped 10 km early; commission orders Rs 31,500
description: A passenger booked an AC bus ticket from Hyderabad to Rajahmundry but was placed in a non-AC bus. After being dropped off 9-10 km from his destination, he faced significant inconvenience at midnight. The consumer commission found the bus operator liable for deficiency of service due to the circumstances experienced by the passenger. It awarded the passenger Rs 31,500 in total for mental harassment and litigation costs.

title: AAP donations drop 68%; ex-MP-turned-BJP leader’s firm had given Rs 5 crore
Rakul Preet, Panorama Studios on I-T radar; 12 Mumbai sites searched
description: The Income Tax Department is currently conducting searches at multiple locations linked to actor Rakul Preet Singh and producer Vashu Bhagnani. Officials are investigating suspected financial irregularities connected to film-related transactions and overseas fund movements. Teams are examining documents and transaction records aiming to uncover details about the financial activities under scrutiny. This action follows a separate investigation involving Rakul's brother Aman Preet Singh linked to drug allegations.

title: After hydrogen, India gets its first LNG train; check details
description: The dual-fuel arrangement allows LNG to substitute for around 40 per cent of diesel consumption. The move is part of the national transporter’s broader push to reduce carbon emissions and move towards more sustainable modes of transport. A full tank of LNG is expected to support around 1,600 km of operations, thereby reducing the frequency with which the train needs to refuel.

title: No irrigation, farmers put up Maharashtra village ‘for sale’
description: Residents of Tulshi village in Maharashtra express their frustration over the lack of irrigation water for decades. Despite being close to a major irrigation project, the village has yet to benefit from it. The ongoing water crisis has intensified with no rainfall recorded in the last 45 days. Villagers have resorted to protests, including an indefinite fast, to demand government action.

title: Motorcycle-borne gunmen kill 3 cops in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
'Against EVMs even if we win': Akhilesh, Mayawati express distrust, cite US, Germany

'Leave us alone': 3 students say LPU posted rape 'truth' video without consent
description: Three female students from Lovely Professional University stated that a video of them was released without their consent. This video allegedly dismissed claims of a rape incident on campus involving a plumber. Following the allegations, students protested and vandalized property and blocked a highway for over 15 hours.

title: Self-defence or safer spaces? What assaults say about how we approach women’s safety
description: Recent incidents of assault against women in Delhi have sparked discussions on the need for personal safety measures. Many women have been advised to learn self-defence as a response to increasing violence. However, experts argue that creating safer public spaces should be prioritized over individual preparedness. Notably, children and vulnerable individuals are often unable to defend themselves against attackers.

title: Houston's Greenspoint Mall to be razed for $150M 80-acre industrial park
description: Greenspoint Mall, a once-popular shopping destination, is set to be demolished for redevelopment. CityNorth Industrial Park will cover approximately 80 acres with an investment of $150 million. This new project will provide logistics and industrial space while supporting approximately 1,200 full-time jobs upon completion. Demolition is scheduled to begin in October 2026, with construction continuing into 2028.

title: Glen Mills grad turned home cooking into digital career with 8M+ followers
description: Shereen Pavlides, a 1990 Garnet Valley High School graduate and former Glen Mills resident, has built a social media career around home cooking. Known as Cooking With Shereen, she now has about 5 million TikTok followers, more than 2 million on Facebook, over 1 million on Instagram and around 1.45 million YouTube subscribers.

title: Why choosing pets over kids may reveal your core values: Psychology
description: Decisions regarding parenthood and pet ownership stem from individual experiences and preferences. Financial considerations play a significant role in deciding between children and pets. Psychologically, bonds with animals are valuable but differ from parent-child relationships. Pets can offer companionship and emotional support without replacing the unique aspects of child-rearing. Ultimately, personal values shape these important life choices for individuals.

title: Investors lose over Rs 8 lakh cr as markets tumble: Why stock market crashed today
description: While Sensex crashed over 1,100 points, Nifty50 went below 22,800. BSE Sensex ended the day at 72,771.72, down 1,124 points or 1.52%. Nifty50 closed at 22,780.25, down 360 points or 1.56%.

title: US labor dept hints at 'total shutdown' of H-1B visa program
description: Anthony D'Esposito, Inspector General at the Department of Labor, announced an investigation into the H-1B visa program. Investigators are focusing on fraud related to foreign labor, which may lead to significant reforms. D'Esposito indicated that the program could look very different in one year. The administration is also examining colleges allegedly exploiting J-1 visas, as part of a wider crackdown.

title: Bill Gates Foundation to shut down in 2045: Why some Americans reject its $400m ‘gift’
description: The Bill Gates Foundation is making a bold move by committing $1 billion to ensure equitable AI development for education and healthcare. Of this, $400 million is dedicated to creating AI-driven tutoring systems that tailor learning experiences. This investment arrives amidst rising discussions about digital tools' effectiveness and privacy issues, with New York City already enacting a one-year pause on generative AI in schools.

title: Festive shopping to pinch as Iran war sets AC, TV prices on fire
Students, faculty of Kolkata's Ray Institute hurt in clashes with RSS-linked outfit
description: Around thirty students and two faculty members from Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute were injured during a clash. This incident occurred when members of ABGP confronted students protesting an event at their auditorium. Injured students were treated at local hospitals, with some suffering serious injuries from the confrontation. Both sides accused the police of inaction, leading to multiple FIRs being lodged.

title: Entitlement, deviant thinking or poor impulse control? Why men commit sexual crimes
description: Psychiatrists explain that many factors contribute to the occurrence of sexual assault, including personality deviations and societal influences. Various motivations may drive assaulters, such as narcissistic entitlement and impulsive behavior. Urbanization and the impact of social media can exacerbate these issues and diminish fear of legal consequences. Education about mental health, gender equality, and respect for women is crucial in prevention.

title: Why 6 minutes can feel like forever at ITO
description: At the ITO intersection in Delhi, daily commuters face overwhelming delays caused by heavy traffic during rush hours. This crucial junction connects key areas, intensifying congestion. Despite attempts from traffic police to manually control signals, their efforts have proven inadequate against the sheer volume of vehicles. Breakdowns and emergencies further disrupt the flow, leaving commuters to grapple with prolonged wait times as much-needed infrastructure changes remain pending.

title: 14-year-old Georgia student scores perfect 1600 on SAT
description: At just 14 years old, Ashrit Talluri from Georgia has achieved remarkable success, scoring a flawless 1600 on the SAT exam. Having earned 14½ high school credits in middle school, he is now taking college-level courses as a ninth grader at Innovation Academy. With five months of meticulous preparation behind him, Ashrit dreams of becoming a neurosurgeon, eager to delve into projects that combine cutting-edge technology with healthcare.
